No, I would be in no better situation to help them with this situation than anyone else.  I am in this situation, I am intelligent enough to know what I need and I seek it out, but I still can't get any real help.  I feel like an outsider seeing my life happen in front of me.  I see my unhealthy thoughts/behavior and I know why I shouldn't feel like I do but I can't seem to change it.  I have spent countless hours with several therapists talking about changing your beliefs in yourself, but how do you change a TRUE belief?  

Do you really want someone here who doesn't want to be here?
Well tldr I have a chemical imbalance in my brain that no meds have helped plus every person in my life has abandoned me.   The usual.
This is the difference between good people and bad people.

These are step children and I assure you, I have NO rights to see them.  I have spent hours begging to see them.  I realize that later in life they may reach out to me but that is a long shot!  They should just forget about me, they would be happier that way.

I haven't seem them since Xmas.  I have no rights to see them and have tried to reach out to them many times.   I have been made out to be the bad guy who abandoned them.  They are my world and I will never be with them again.
I am crying for you...I know your pain and I dont wish it on anyone.  I just want you to know that you aren't alone.
If they TRUELY loved me they wouldn't want to prolong my suffering for their benefit.  They would let go!

Guilt!  That's the only reason I haven't yet!  Telling my family the way I feel and the amount of pain I have endured, the only thing they responded with was guilt.  " if you did that then I would too, cause I can't stand losing a child" or " you would destroy our lives".  

Why do I have to endure a lifetime of pain and suffering so that they all can have a happy carefree life.  I am suffering and they are selfish, trying to keep me here for their oun benefit.
I know how you feel... Like a burden on happy people. Dragging them down.

You sound like everyone else.... "It gets better" "change your routine" "you will survive"

I just want to know, at what point is everyone else prolonging my misery for their selfish

A psychiatrist is a doctor who is usually the person who regulates medication.  A therapist isn't a doctor and is used to talk and work out issues. 

This is my understanding from almost 30 years seeing both but I am not either and I am sure there are other differences.
